revisions.goal: Optimize loading performance for the individual repository page without changing its user-visible behavior.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria: The individual repository page renders the same content and interactions, its critical loading path is measurably faster in the local reproduction, relevant tests/builds pass, and the change is recorded in EVE with verification results.

milestones.title: Measure current repository page loading
milestones.goal: Identify the slow request or render path and capture a repeatable baseline.

milestones.title: Implement targeted optimization
milestones.goal: Reduce the measured bottleneck while preserving repository page behavior.

milestones.title: Verify and record the change
milestones.goal: Run focused and project verification, then complete the EVE snapshot.
